integrity: The exact infinite formula is proved via zero-run decomposition and carry parity; exhaustive testing for m<=8 is supporting evidence, not a substitute for proof. Earlier zero-run formulas are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Binary RM(1,m) in increasing binary-integer evaluation order only; coordinate permutations can change cyclic b-symbol weights. Does not classify higher order or nonbinary codes.
title: Complete cyclic window-weight enumerators of ordered first-order binary Reed–Muller codes
